subject: Physics
title: Distance under constant acceleration
prompt: Solve the distance traveled by a cart starting from rest, accelerating at 2 m/s² for 4 s. Animate the cart and a synchronized velocity-time graph.
learner: Knows velocity; new to constant acceleration.
styleBrief: Technical diagram: moving cart on a track, attached velocity arrow, graph on the right, compact calculation.
criteria: Displacement is 16 m; final velocity is 8 m/s.
Cart position grows quadratically with simulated time; velocity grows linearly.
Distinguish simulated time from video playback time.
